description: This file defines the 'ConceptProposal' class, which models a proposal for creating or editing a medical concept within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes fields for tracking proposal details, status, associated encounter, and audit information, as well as methods for manipulating these fields.

classes.name: ConceptProposal
classes.description: A class representing a proposal for a medical concept within the OpenMRS system, including details about the proposal's content, status, related encounter, and audit information.

methods.name: rejectConceptProposal
methods.description: Marks the proposal as rejected by updating its state and clearing the final text.
